jp: \t\t二度焼きされた磁器でできた人形。貴族の女子たちに人気。特殊な術式を用いて魔力を込めると、動き出すようになるというウワサがある。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t二度焼きされた磁器でできた人形。貴族の女子たちに人気。特殊な術式を用いて魔力を込めると、動き出すようになるというウワサがある。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Dolls made of twice-fired porcelain. Popular among noble girls. Rumor has it that if a special formula is used to put magic power into the doll, it will start to move. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Dolls made of twice-fired porcelain. Popular among noble girls. Rumor has it that if a special formula is used to put magic power into the doll, it will start to move. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Bambole fatte di porcellana cotta due volte. Piacciono molto alle ragazze di nobile famiglia. Corre voce che, infondendovi il potere magico con una formula speciale, si mettano a muoversi. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t綺麗な装飾が施された見事な陶器。特に芸術的な品は高値で取引され、食器ではなくインテリアとして用いられたりする。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t綺麗な装飾が施された見事な陶器。特に芸術的な品は高値で取引され、食器ではなくインテリアとして用いられたりする。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Exquisite ceramics with beautiful decorations. Artistic pieces in particular fetch high prices and are often used not as tableware but as interior decorations. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Exquisite ceramics with beautiful decorations. Artistic pieces in particular fetch high prices and are often used not as tableware but as interior decorations. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Ceramiche magnifiche, ornate con grande finezza. I pezzi più artistici si vendono a caro prezzo, e spesso non si usano come stoviglie ma come arredo. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t古代文明の墓に並べられていたとされる焼き物を再現。愛嬌のある造形だが、暗い所で見るとちょっと怖い。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t古代文明の墓に並べられていたとされる焼き物を再現。愛嬌のある造形だが、暗い所で見るとちょっと怖い。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Reproduction of pottery said to have been laid out in the tombs of ancient civilizations. The modeling is charming, but a little scary when seen in the dark. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Reproduction of pottery said to have been laid out in the tombs of ancient civilizations. The modeling is charming, but a little scary when seen in the dark. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Riproduzione delle ceramiche che, si dice, stavano allineate nelle tombe delle civiltà antiche. La forma ha la sua grazia, ma al buio mette un po' di paura. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\tオパートスの姿の振り子。どこかの職人がオパートスから剥がれた岩を加工して作っているらしい。鉱石類と反応し、ぐるぐる回ったり高笑いしたりする。埋まっている鉱石を掘り出す際に見逃しが減るのでは、と鉱夫の間で話題になっている。\n#～いいもの選ぼう職人道具～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tオパートスの姿の振り子。どこかの職人がオパートスから剥がれた岩を加工して作っているらしい。鉱石類と反応し、ぐるぐる回ったり高笑いしたりする。埋まっている鉱石を掘り出す際に見逃しが減るのでは、と鉱夫の間で話題になっている。\n#～いいもの選ぼう職人道具～\n"
en: A pendulum in the shape of Opatos. It seems to be made by some craftsman working on a rock stripped from Opatos himself. It reacts with ores and spins around and laughs. There is talk among miners that it may reduce the chance of missing buried ores when digging them out. \n# ~Choosing the Best Tools for the Best Craftsmen~
en_grezzo: "A pendulum in the shape of Opatos. It seems to be made by some craftsman working on a rock stripped from Opatos himself. It reacts with ores and spins around and laughs. There is talk among miners that it may reduce the chance of missing buried ores when digging them out. \n# ~Choosing the Best Tools for the Best Craftsmen~"
it: Un pendolo a forma di Opatos. Pare che un certo artigiano lo ricavi dalla roccia staccata da Opatos stesso. Reagisce ai minerali: gira su sé stesso e ride forte. Fra i minatori si dice che, a scavare, faccia sfuggire di meno il metallo sepolto. \n# ~Scegliere Bene gli Attrezzi da Artigiano~

jp: \t\tクミロミが自分を模して作った巨大なぬいぐるみ。先代エヘカトルに数えきれないほど贈られたが、全て下界に捨てられていた。その正体はエヘカトルに近寄る者を殺すための呪具。誰も見ていない時に動き出して周囲の生物を襲う。畑に置いておくと害獣を殺すので便利。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tクミロミが自分を模して作った巨大なぬいぐるみ。先代エヘカトルに数えきれないほど贈られたが、全て下界に捨てられていた。その正体はエヘカトルに近寄る者を殺すための呪具。誰も見ていない時に動き出して周囲の生物を襲う。畑に置いておくと害獣を殺すので便利。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: A giant stuffed doll made by Kumiromi in his own image. It was previously given to Ehekatl countless times, but all of them were discarded in the human world. Its true functionality is that it is a cursed tool to kill anyone who comes close to Ehekatl. It moves when no one is looking and attacks surrounding creatures. It is useful to leave it in the field to kill vermin. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "A giant stuffed doll made by Kumiromi in his own image. It was previously given to Ehekatl countless times, but all of them were discarded in the human world. Its true functionality is that it is a cursed tool to kill anyone who comes close to Ehekatl. It moves when no one is looking and attacks surrounding creatures. It is useful to leave it in the field to kill vermin. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Un enorme peluche che Kumiromi ha fatto a propria immagine. Ne regalò alla precedente Ehekatl un numero incalcolabile, e lei li buttò tutti quaggiù. In verità è un oggetto maledetto, fatto per uccidere chi si avvicina a Ehekatl: si muove quando nessuno guarda e assale le creature intorno. Lasciato nel campo fa comodo, perché ammazza gli animali nocivi. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\tイツパロトルの姿を模した厳かなインテリア。猛る炎の魔神としての側面を強調した作品。敬虔すぎる信者が土下座で頼み込んでイツパロトルの炎を採取し、狂ったように量産したという。魔力を帯びた原初の炎を灯しており、調理の下ごしらえに応用すると呪いも祝福も焼き尽くす。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tイツパロトルの姿を模した厳かなインテリア。猛る炎の魔神としての側面を強調した作品。敬虔すぎる信者が土下座で頼み込んでイツパロトルの炎を採取し、狂ったように量産したという。魔力を帯びた原初の炎を灯しており、調理の下ごしらえに応用すると呪いも祝福も焼き尽くす。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: The austere decor that imitates the figure of Itzpalt. It is said that an overly devout believer asked on his knees to collect Itzpalt's flame and mass-produced it like crazy. It is lit by a primordial flame that is charged with magical power, and when applied to the preparation of food, it burns away both curses and blessings. \n# ~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "The austere decor that imitates the figure of Itzpalt. It is said that an overly devout believer asked on his knees to collect Itzpalt's flame and mass-produced it like crazy. It is lit by a primordial flame that is charged with magical power, and when applied to the preparation of food, it burns away both curses and blessings. \n# ~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un arredo solenne che riproduce la figura di Itzpalt, e ne accentua il lato di demone del fuoco furioso. Si racconta che un fedele troppo devoto implorò in ginocchio di poter raccogliere la fiamma di Itzpalt, e poi ne fece produzione di massa come un forsennato. Dentro arde la fiamma primordiale carica di magia: applicata alla preparazione dei cibi, brucia via tanto le maledizioni quanto le benedizioni. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t幸運を呼ぶ魚を抱えたエヘカトル…という世にも珍しいシーンを目撃した、無名の画家の作品。興奮した画家は借金してまで大量の版画を作ったが、全く評価されず無名のまま死んでいった。彼の死後、この絵を家に飾っておくと嫌な客が招かれなくなるという事実が明らかになり、再評価の流れがきている。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t幸運を呼ぶ魚を抱えたエヘカトル…という世にも珍しいシーンを目撃した、無名の画家の作品。興奮した画家は借金してまで大量の版画を作ったが、全く評価されず無名のまま死んでいった。彼の死後、この絵を家に飾っておくと嫌な客が招かれなくなるという事実が明らかになり、再評価の流れがきている。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Ehekatl holding a lucky fish...an unknown painter who witnessed an unusual scene in the world. The artist was so excited that he borrowed money to make a large number of prints, but they were not appreciated at all and he died in obscurity. After his death, it was revealed that if this painting was hung in the house, unwanted guests would no longer be invited, and there has been a trend toward reevaluation of the work. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Ehekatl holding a lucky fish...an unknown painter who witnessed an unusual scene in the world. The artist was so excited that he borrowed money to make a large number of prints, but they were not appreciated at all and he died in obscurity. After his death, it was revealed that if this painting was hung in the house, unwanted guests would no longer be invited, and there has been a trend toward reevaluation of the work. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Opera di un pittore ignoto che assistette a una scena rarissima al mondo: Ehekatl che stringe fra le braccia il pesce che porta fortuna. Entusiasta, l'artista si indebitò per stamparne una gran quantità, ma nessuno le apprezzò e lui morì sconosciuto. Dopo la sua morte si scoprì che questo quadro, appeso in casa, tiene lontani gli ospiti sgraditi, e ora c'è chi lo rivaluta. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t眠ってから８時間経過すると無理やり起こしてくれる時計。頭を小突くと止まる。かつては秘宝の代わりに信者へ配られていたらしいが、過激なルルウィ信者に奪われて破壊される事件が多発し、生産中止になった。マニアの間ではプレミアがついているが一般人にその価値はわからない。\n#～発見！世界の珍品～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t眠ってから８時間経過すると無理やり起こしてくれる時計。頭を小突くと止まる。かつては秘宝の代わりに信者へ配られていたらしいが、過激なルルウィ信者に奪われて破壊される事件が多発し、生産中止になった。マニアの間ではプレミアがついているが一般人にその価値はわからない。\n#～発見！世界の珍品～\n"
en: A clock that forces you to wake up after 8 hours of sleep. A poke to the head will stop it. It is said that it used to be distributed to believers in place of the hidden treasure, but production was discontinued after many incidents of it being stolen and destroyed by militant Lulwy believers. It has a premium among enthusiasts, but the general public has no idea of its value. \n# ~Discovery! Curiosities of the World~
en_grezzo: "A clock that forces you to wake up after 8 hours of sleep. A poke to the head will stop it. It is said that it used to be distributed to believers in place of the hidden treasure, but production was discontinued after many incidents of it being stolen and destroyed by militant Lulwy believers. It has a premium among enthusiasts, but the general public has no idea of its value. \n# ~Discovery! Curiosities of the World~"
it: Un orologio che, passate otto ore di sonno, sveglia per forza. Si ferma dandogli un colpetto in testa. Pare che un tempo lo distribuissero ai fedeli al posto del tesoro sacro, ma i seguaci più accesi di Lulwy lo rubavano e lo distruggevano di continuo, e la produzione fu sospesa. Fra gli appassionati vale un premio; la gente comune non ne capisce il valore. \n# ~Scoperta! Le Rarità del Mondo~

jp: \t\t環境に負けず咲き続けるすごい花。生化学文明の技術で枯れないように改良されたものが野生化したらしい。観賞用以外に学術的にもある程度の価値がある。元は古代の植物だったらしいが、生命力が強くなりすぎてしまった感がある。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t環境に負けず咲き続けるすごい花。生化学文明の技術で枯れないように改良されたものが野生化したらしい。観賞用以外に学術的にもある程度の価値がある。元は古代の植物だったらしいが、生命力が強くなりすぎてしまった感がある。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n"
en: Impressive flower that continues to bloom regardless of its environment. It is said that it was improved by the technology of biochemical civilization so that it would not wither, and then it spread into the wild. Besides being ornamental, it has a certain amount of academic value. Although it is an ancient plant, it seems to have developed strong vitality. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~
en_grezzo: "Impressive flower that continues to bloom regardless of its environment. It is said that it was improved by the technology of biochemical civilization so that it would not wither, and then it spread into the wild. Besides being ornamental, it has a certain amount of academic value. Although it is an ancient plant, it seems to have developed strong vitality. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~"
it: Un fiore straordinario, che continua a fiorire qualunque cosa gli capiti intorno. Pare che la tecnica della civiltà biochimica lo avesse migliorato perché non appassisse, e che poi sia tornato allo stato selvatico. Oltre che ornamentale ha un certo valore per gli studiosi. All'origine era una pianta antica, ma la forza vitale gli è cresciuta troppo. \n# ~Atlante Illustrato del Giardinaggio di Tyris~

jp: \t\t食材を細かく粉砕し絞る調理器具。料理の技術が無くても、放り込んでスイッチを押せば勝手に圧汁してくれる。手軽にジュースが作れる優れもの。\n#～料理を支える脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t食材を細かく粉砕し絞る調理器具。料理の技術が無くても、放り込んでスイッチを押せば勝手に圧汁してくれる。手軽にジュースが作れる優れもの。\n#～料理を支える脇役達～\n"
en: A cooking utensil that crushes and squeezes food into small pieces. Even if you do not have cooking skills, just throw in the ingredients and press the switch, and it will squeeze the juice on its own. It is an excellent tool for making juice easily. \n# ~Supporting Roles in Kitchen~
en_grezzo: "A cooking utensil that crushes and squeezes food into small pieces. Even if you do not have cooking skills, just throw in the ingredients and press the switch, and it will squeeze the juice on its own. It is an excellent tool for making juice easily. \n# ~Supporting Roles in Kitchen~"
it: Un utensile da cucina che tritura gli ingredienti e li spreme. Anche senza saper cucinare basta buttarci dentro la roba e premere il pulsante: il succo lo tira fuori da sé. Ottimo arnese per farsi un succo senza fatica. \n# ~I Comprimari della Cucina~

jp: \t\t羊の形をしたモコモコの巨大安眠枕。「広大な草原で、心地よい風に吹かれながら寝ている羊になった夢」を見られるらしい。ただ、稀に孤独感を覚え、寂しくなってふと目が覚めることがある。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t羊の形をしたモコモコの巨大安眠枕。「広大な草原で、心地よい風に吹かれながら寝ている羊になった夢」を見られるらしい。ただ、稀に孤独感を覚え、寂しくなってふと目が覚めることがある。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A huge, fuzzy, restful sleep pillow in the shape of a sheep. However, on rare occasions, I feel lonely and I wake up suddenly feeling lonely. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A huge, fuzzy, restful sleep pillow in the shape of a sheep. However, on rare occasions, I feel lonely and I wake up suddenly feeling lonely. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un enorme cuscino soffice a forma di pecora, per dormire bene. Pare che faccia sognare di essere una pecora che dorme in una prateria sconfinata, con addosso un vento gradevole. Ogni tanto però prende un senso di solitudine, e ci si sveglia di soprassalto sentendosi soli.\n#~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t純白の天使を模した像。翼の部分は壊れやすいのでうかつに触ってはいけない。台座の上に乗るとなんだか翼が生えた気分になれるとか。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t純白の天使を模した像。翼の部分は壊れやすいのでうかつに触ってはいけない。台座の上に乗るとなんだか翼が生えた気分になれるとか。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: A statue in the shape of a pure white angel. The wings are fragile and should not be touched carelessly. It is said that if you stand on the pedestal, you will feel as if you have grown wings. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "A statue in the shape of a pure white angel. The wings are fragile and should not be touched carelessly. It is said that if you stand on the pedestal, you will feel as if you have grown wings. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Una statua a forma di angelo candido. Le ali sono fragili e non vanno toccate alla leggera. Dicono che a salire sul piedistallo venga la sensazione di aver messo le ali. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t小さいストーンゴーレム。サイズは小さくても、魔力を注げばちゃんと起動する。現在ではあまり見られない、クラシックなデザイン。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t小さいストーンゴーレム。サイズは小さくても、魔力を注げばちゃんと起動する。現在ではあまり見られない、クラシックなデザイン。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: A small stone golem. Although small in size, it can be properly activated by pouring magic power into it. It is a classic design that is rarely seen today. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "A small stone golem. Although small in size, it can be properly activated by pouring magic power into it. It is a classic design that is rarely seen today. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Un piccolo golem di pietra. Piccolo sì, ma se gli si infonde il potere magico si attiva come si deve. È un disegno classico, che oggi non si vede quasi più. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t苦悩の人々をその無限の大慈悲の心で包み込み、救うという石像。一般的には子供たちの守り神ともされる。雪よけの笠を被せてあげると恩返しに来るとか来ないとか。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t苦悩の人々をその無限の大慈悲の心で包み込み、救うという石像。一般的には子供たちの守り神ともされる。雪よけの笠を被せてあげると恩返しに来るとか来ないとか。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Stone statues that are said to save people in distress by enveloping them with their infinite great compassion. It is also generally regarded as a guardian deity for children. It is said that if you put a hat on it to protect it from the snow, it will return the favor or not. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Stone statues that are said to save people in distress by enveloping them with their infinite great compassion. It is also generally regarded as a guardian deity for children. It is said that if you put a hat on it to protect it from the snow, it will return the favor or not. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Una statua di pietra che, si dice, avvolge chi soffre nella sua misericordia infinita e lo salva. In genere la si considera anche la divinità che protegge i bambini. Dicono che a metterle in testa un cappello di paglia contro la neve venga a sdebitarsi; o forse no. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t古代宗教の信仰対象を模した像。御神木などの神聖な木を使うこともあるが見た目上の違いは特に出ない。美術的に価値があり、コレクターもいる。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t古代宗教の信仰対象を模した像。御神木などの神聖な木を使うこともあるが見た目上の違いは特に出ない。美術的に価値があり、コレクターもいる。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Statues that imitate the objects of belief of ancient religions. Sacred trees such as sacred trees are sometimes used, but there is no particular difference in appearance. They have artistic value and are collected by some collectors. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Statues that imitate the objects of belief of ancient religions. Sacred trees such as sacred trees are sometimes used, but there is no particular difference in appearance. They have artistic value and are collected by some collectors. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Una statua che riproduce l'oggetto di culto di una religione antica. A volte la si intaglia in un legno sacro, come quello degli alberi consacrati, ma a vederla non cambia niente. Ha valore artistico, e c'è chi le colleziona. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t小さいウッドゴーレム。サイズは小さくても、魔力を注げばちゃんと起動する。現在ではあまり見られない、クラシックなデザイン。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t小さいウッドゴーレム。サイズは小さくても、魔力を注げばちゃんと起動する。現在ではあまり見られない、クラシックなデザイン。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: A small wooden golem. Although small in size, it can be properly activated by pouring magic power into it. It is a classic design that is rarely seen today. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "A small wooden golem. Although small in size, it can be properly activated by pouring magic power into it. It is a classic design that is rarely seen today. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Un piccolo golem di legno. Piccolo sì, ma se gli si infonde il potere magico si attiva come si deve. È un disegno classico, che oggi non si vede quasi più. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\tペット用の小屋。隙間風が入らないように丁寧に作られている。狭い所を好む生き物には居心地が良いだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tペット用の小屋。隙間風が入らないように丁寧に作られている。狭い所を好む生き物には居心地が良いだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Shed for pets. It is carefully constructed to prevent ventilation. It will be cozy for creatures that like small spaces. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Shed for pets. It is carefully constructed to prevent ventilation. It will be cozy for creatures that like small spaces. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una casetta per gli animali domestici. È fatta con cura, perché non ci passi uno spiffero. Chi ama gli spazi stretti ci starà comodo. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t陶器で作られた涙滴状の楽器。形状や穴の数などは決まっていない。リコーダーとほぼ同じ構造の歌口を持ち、音を出しやすい。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t陶器で作られた涙滴状の楽器。形状や穴の数などは決まっていない。リコーダーとほぼ同じ構造の歌口を持ち、音を出しやすい。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n"
en: A teardrop-shaped instrument made of ceramics. It has no fixed shape or number of holes. It has a singing mouth almost the same structure as a recorder, making it easy to produce sound. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~
en_grezzo: "A teardrop-shaped instrument made of ceramics. It has no fixed shape or number of holes. It has a singing mouth almost the same structure as a recorder, making it easy to produce sound. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~"
it: Uno strumento di ceramica a forma di goccia. La forma e il numero dei fori non sono fissi. Ha un'imboccatura quasi identica a quella del flauto dolce, e il suono viene facile. \n# ~Le Melodie della Limpida Irva~

jp: \t\t記録するもの、の名を持つ縦笛。フィップルという特殊構造により空気の束が安定し、容易な吹奏を可能としている。一方で音量が小さく音色にも表情がつけにくいため、初心者用の楽器として位置づけられている。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t記録するもの、の名を持つ縦笛。フィップルという特殊構造により空気の束が安定し、容易な吹奏を可能としている。一方で音量が小さく音色にも表情がつけにくいため、初心者用の楽器として位置づけられている。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n"
en: A vertical flute with the name of 'recorder'. The special fipple structure stabilizes the air bundle and makes it easy to play. On the other hand, it is positioned as a beginner's instrument because its volume is low and its tone is difficult to express. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~
en_grezzo: "A vertical flute with the name of 'recorder'. The special fipple structure stabilizes the air bundle and makes it easy to play. On the other hand, it is positioned as a beginner's instrument because its volume is low and its tone is difficult to express. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~"
it: Un flauto diritto: il nome che porta in un'altra lingua vuol dire chi registra. Una struttura particolare, il becco, tiene ferma la colonna d'aria e rende facile suonarlo. In compenso ha poco volume e un timbro difficile da colorare, e per questo lo si tiene per uno strumento da principianti. \n# ~Le Melodie della Limpida Irva~

jp: \t\tとても太くて長くて、黒光りしている金管楽器。主に音量の補強に用いられるが、実際に使われることは少なく今や絶滅危惧楽器である。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tとても太くて長くて、黒光りしている金管楽器。主に音量の補強に用いられるが、実際に使われることは少なく今や絶滅危惧楽器である。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n"
en: A very thick, long, shiny black brass instrument. It is mainly used to reinforce the volume, but is rarely used in practice and is now an endangered instrument. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~
en_grezzo: "A very thick, long, shiny black brass instrument. It is mainly used to reinforce the volume, but is rarely used in practice and is now an endangered instrument. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~"
it: Un ottone molto grosso, molto lungo e nero lucente. Serve soprattutto a rinforzare il volume, ma in pratica lo si usa di rado ed è ormai uno strumento a rischio di estinzione. \n# ~Le Melodie della Limpida Irva~

jp: \t\t魔法で動く飛行船を忠実に再現したノンスケールのミニチュア。残念ながら浮いたりはしない。\n#～イルヴァ航空販売カタログ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t魔法で動く飛行船を忠実に再現したノンスケールのミニチュア。残念ながら浮いたりはしない。\n#～イルヴァ航空販売カタログ～\n"
en: This non-scale miniature is a faithful reproduction of a magically powered airship. Unfortunately, it does not float.\n# ~Irva Airlines Sales Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "This non-scale miniature is a faithful reproduction of a magically powered airship. Unfortunately, it does not float.\n# ~Irva Airlines Sales Catalogue~"
it: Una miniatura fuori scala che riproduce fedelmente una nave magica volante. Purtroppo non sta a galla.\n# ~Catalogo di Vendita di Irva Airlines~

jp: \t\t口を開けた狛犬。獅子と呼ぶ場合もある。向かって右側に置こう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t口を開けた狛犬。獅子と呼ぶ場合もある。向かって右側に置こう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A guardian dog with its mouth open. Sometimes called a lion. Place it on the right side of the gate. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A guardian dog with its mouth open. Sometimes called a lion. Place it on the right side of the gate. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un koma-inu con la bocca aperta. C'è chi lo chiama leone. Va messo a destra, guardando il cancello. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t口を閉じた狛犬。向かって左側に置こう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t口を閉じた狛犬。向かって左側に置こう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A guardian dog with its mouth open. Sometimes called a lion. Place it on the left side of the gate. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A guardian dog with its mouth open. Sometimes called a lion. Place it on the left side of the gate. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un koma-inu con la bocca chiusa. Va messo a sinistra, guardando il cancello. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t拷問に用いる木製の責め具。本人の体重で股間に苦痛を与える。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t拷問に用いる木製の責め具。本人の体重で股間に苦痛を与える。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A wooden torture device. It inflicts pain on the groin using the person's body weight. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A wooden torture device. It inflicts pain on the groin using the person's body weight. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un attrezzo di tortura in legno. Fa male all'inguine sfruttando il peso di chi ci sta sopra. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t「我々の業界ではご褒美です！」\n#～目覚めてしまった冒険者の言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「我々の業界ではご褒美です！」\n#～目覚めてしまった冒険者の言葉～\n"
en: \"It's a reward in our trade!\" \n# ~words of an adventurer who has entered a new world~
en_grezzo: "\"It's a reward in our trade!\" \n# ~words of an adventurer who has entered a new world~"
it: \"Nel nostro giro è un premio!\" \n# ~Parole di un Avventuriero che si è Risvegliato~

jp: \t\t木でできた胴に皮を張って作った打楽器。一般的に残響が非常に良く響き、余韻が残るのが特徴。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t木でできた胴に皮を張って作った打楽器。一般的に残響が非常に良く響き、余韻が残るのが特徴。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n"
en: A percussion instrument made with a body made of wood and lined with leather. It is generally characterized by a very good reverberation and lingering sound. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~
en_grezzo: "A percussion instrument made with a body made of wood and lined with leather. It is generally characterized by a very good reverberation and lingering sound. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~"
it: Uno strumento a percussione fatto di una cassa di legno con la pelle tesa sopra. In genere risuona benissimo, e la coda del suono resta a lungo. \n# ~Le Melodie della Limpida Irva~

jp: \t\t浜辺の砂を用いて作られた見事なお城。泳ぎに来たのに砂遊びに熱中してしまった者の作品。がっちりと固められており意外と丈夫。\n#～ノースティリス紀行・夏版～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t浜辺の砂を用いて作られた見事なお城。泳ぎに来たのに砂遊びに熱中してしまった者の作品。がっちりと固められており意外と丈夫。\n#～ノースティリス紀行・夏版～\n"
en: It is a magnificent castle made of sand from the beach. This is the work of a person who came here to swim but got absorbed in playing in the sand. It is solid and surprisingly strong.\n# ~North Tyris Travels - Summer Edition~
en_grezzo: "It is a magnificent castle made of sand from the beach. This is the work of a person who came here to swim but got absorbed in playing in the sand. It is solid and surprisingly strong.\n# ~North Tyris Travels - Summer Edition~"
it: Un magnifico castello fatto con la sabbia della spiaggia. Opera di qualcuno che era venuto per nuotare e si è perso a giocare con la sabbia. È ben compattato, e più solido di quanto sembri.\n# ~Viaggio in Tyris del Nord: Estate~

jp: \t\t料理を載せる為に用いる平坦な食器。ピンからキリまであり、日常的に広く使われる物から、馬が買えてしまうような驚くべき価値のものも存在するという。\n#～料理を支える脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t料理を載せる為に用いる平坦な食器。ピンからキリまであり、日常的に広く使われる物から、馬が買えてしまうような驚くべき価値のものも存在するという。\n#～料理を支える脇役達～\n"
en: Flatware used to place food on. They range from the most expensive to the most expensive, and some are widely used in daily life, while others are so valuable that they are equivalent to the price of a horse. \n# ~Supporting Roles in Kitchen~
en_grezzo: "Flatware used to place food on. They range from the most expensive to the most expensive, and some are widely used in daily life, while others are so valuable that they are equivalent to the price of a horse. \n# ~Supporting Roles in Kitchen~"
it: Una stoviglia piatta su cui si mette il cibo. Ce n'è di ogni sorta, dalla migliore alla peggiore: certe si usano tutti i giorni, altre valgono tanto da poterci comprare un cavallo. \n# ~I Comprimari della Cucina~

jp: \t\t仕留めた猛獣の皮をなめして調度品としたもの。丸々一頭贅沢に使ったその佇まいは、そこに未だ野性が残っていると思わせるほどだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t仕留めた猛獣の皮をなめして調度品としたもの。丸々一頭贅沢に使ったその佇まいは、そこに未だ野性が残っていると思わせるほどだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: The skins of wild beasts are tanned and used as furnishings. The appearance of the luxurious use of a whole animal is enough to make one believe that there is still some wildness left in the animal. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "The skins of wild beasts are tanned and used as furnishings. The appearance of the luxurious use of a whole animal is enough to make one believe that there is still some wildness left in the animal. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: La pelle di una bestia feroce abbattuta, conciata e ridotta a suppellettile. Usarne una intera è un lusso, e l'insieme dà l'impressione che là dentro sia rimasto qualcosa di selvatico. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t仕留めた獣の頭部に特殊な加工処理を施し調度品としたもの。飾るだけには飽き足らず、自ら狩ったものを加工することで所有欲を満たす貴族もいるようだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t仕留めた獣の頭部に特殊な加工処理を施し調度品としたもの。飾るだけには飽き足らず、自ら狩ったものを加工することで所有欲を満たす貴族もいるようだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: The head of a hunted beast is given a special treatment and made into a furnishing. Some aristocrats are not satisfied with merely decorating, but rather satisfy their desires to possess by processing their own hunted animals. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "The head of a hunted beast is given a special treatment and made into a furnishing. Some aristocrats are not satisfied with merely decorating, but rather satisfy their desires to possess by processing their own hunted animals. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: La testa di una bestia abbattuta, trattata in modo speciale e ridotta a suppellettile. C'è qualche nobile a cui non basta appenderla: si lavora da sé la preda che ha cacciato, e così si sazia la voglia di possesso. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t非常に肌触りのよい毛皮を用いた、見るからに高そうな長椅子。座り心地は抜群だが些かデリケートな家具なので、手入れには非常に神経を使うだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t非常に肌触りのよい毛皮を用いた、見るからに高そうな長椅子。座り心地は抜群だが些かデリケートな家具なので、手入れには非常に神経を使うだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: This is an expensive-looking chaise longue made of very soft fur. It is a very comfortable but rather delicate piece of furniture that requires a great deal of care. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "This is an expensive-looking chaise longue made of very soft fur. It is a very comfortable but rather delicate piece of furniture that requires a great deal of care. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un divano dall'aria costosa, rivestito di una pelliccia morbidissima. Ci si sta benissimo seduti, ma è un mobile un po' delicato e tenerlo in ordine costerà parecchie attenzioni. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t非常に触り心地の良い、格調高い戸棚。どことなく大人の雰囲気を醸し出している。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t非常に触り心地の良い、格調高い戸棚。どことなく大人の雰囲気を醸し出している。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A very tactile and prestigious cupboard. It has a somewhat sophisticated atmosphere. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A very tactile and prestigious cupboard. It has a somewhat sophisticated atmosphere. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un armadietto di gran classe, piacevolissimo al tatto. Ha un che di adulto nell'aria che si porta dietro. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\tありとあらゆる種類の書物が入りそうな本棚。話によれば、去る歴史研究家が飽和した本を整理する為に理想的な家具を注文したのが発端だという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tありとあらゆる種類の書物が入りそうな本棚。話によれば、去る歴史研究家が飽和した本を整理する為に理想的な家具を注文したのが発端だという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A bookcase that could hold all kinds of books. According to the story, it all started when a retired historian ordered the ideal furniture to organize his stacks of books. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A bookcase that could hold all kinds of books. According to the story, it all started when a retired historian ordered the ideal furniture to organize his stacks of books. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una libreria in cui pare ci stiano libri di ogni sorta. A quanto si racconta, tutto cominciò quando uno storico ormai ritirato ordinò il mobile ideale per mettere in ordine i libri che gli traboccavano. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t小型のクリスマスツリー。祭りを祝いたいが樹木を家に置くスペースが無い、といった事情にお答えした一般家庭用のツリーだ。\n#～ノースティリス紀行・冬版～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t小型のクリスマスツリー。祭りを祝いたいが樹木を家に置くスペースが無い、といった事情にお答えした一般家庭用のツリーだ。\n#～ノースティリス紀行・冬版～\n"
en: Small Christmas tree. This is a tree for the average homeowner who wants to celebrate the festival but does not have space for a tree in their home. \n# ~North Tyris Travels, Winter Edition~
en_grezzo: "Small Christmas tree. This is a tree for the average homeowner who wants to celebrate the festival but does not have space for a tree in their home. \n# ~North Tyris Travels, Winter Edition~"
it: Un piccolo albero di Natale. È l'albero per la famiglia comune, che vuole festeggiare ma non ha in casa lo spazio per un albero vero. \n# ~Viaggio in Tyris del Nord: Inverno~

jp: \t\t祝い事の為に特別に作られた飾り。異国の神が降り立つ為の目印であると考えられている。\n#～ノースティリス紀行・冬版～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t祝い事の為に特別に作られた飾り。異国の神が降り立つ為の目印であると考えられている。\n#～ノースティリス紀行・冬版～\n"
en: An ornament made especially for celebrations. It is believed to be a marker for the descent of an exotic deity. \n# ~North Tyris Travels, Winter Edition~
en_grezzo: "An ornament made especially for celebrations. It is believed to be a marker for the descent of an exotic deity. \n# ~North Tyris Travels, Winter Edition~"
it: Un ornamento fatto apposta per le feste. Si ritiene che serva da segnale perché un dio straniero possa scendere. \n# ~Viaggio in Tyris del Nord: Inverno~

jp: \t\t癒しの女神が描かれた優しい抱き心地の枕。長い棒状のそれを抱くことで信者のみならず、使った者全てを女神自らが眠りの淵へ誘い、夢の中で心身を癒してくれるという。\n#～あなたの見知らぬ世界～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t癒しの女神が描かれた優しい抱き心地の枕。長い棒状のそれを抱くことで信者のみならず、使った者全てを女神自らが眠りの淵へ誘い、夢の中で心身を癒してくれるという。\n#～あなたの見知らぬ世界～\n"
en: Hugpillow with a Goddess of Healing printed on it. It is said that by holding the long stick-shaped pillow, the Goddess herself lures not only believers but also all who use it into the depths of sleep and heals their body and soul in their dreams. \n#~ Worlds you've Never Seen~
en_grezzo: "Hugpillow with a Goddess of Healing printed on it. It is said that by holding the long stick-shaped pillow, the Goddess herself lures not only believers but also all who use it into the depths of sleep and heals their body and soul in their dreams. \n#~ Worlds you've Never Seen~"
it: Un cuscino da abbracciare, morbido, con sopra dipinta la dea della cura. Dicono che, stringendo quel lungo cilindro, la dea in persona porti al fondo del sonno non solo i fedeli ma chiunque lo usi, e che nel sogno gli guarisca il corpo e l'animo.\n#~I Mondi che Non Hai Mai Visto~

jp: \t\t祭りの際、物を販売する為に簡易的に作られた露店。通る時に何やら涼しげな音がすることがある。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t祭りの際、物を販売する為に簡易的に作られた露店。通る時に何やら涼しげな音がすることがある。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A simple stall built to sell things during a festival. You may hear some kind of refreshing sound when you pass by. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A simple stall built to sell things during a festival. You may hear some kind of refreshing sound when you pass by. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una bancarella tirata su alla svelta per vendere roba durante una festa. A passarci accanto, certe volte si sente un suono che dà fresco. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t祭りの際、物を販売する為に簡易的に作られた露店。通る時に何やら酸味の混じった香ばしい匂いがすることがある。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t祭りの際、物を販売する為に簡易的に作られた露店。通る時に何やら酸味の混じった香ばしい匂いがすることがある。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A simple stall built to sell things during a festival. There is sometimes a savory smell mixed with some kind of sourness as you pass by. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A simple stall built to sell things during a festival. There is sometimes a savory smell mixed with some kind of sourness as you pass by. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una bancarella tirata su alla svelta per vendere roba durante una festa. A passarci accanto, certe volte si sente un profumo tostato con dentro una punta di acido. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t対話や会計等に用いる、仕切りを兼ねた家具。この家具越しに会話するとさながら店を開いた気分になるという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t対話や会計等に用いる、仕切りを兼ねた家具。この家具越しに会話するとさながら店を開いた気分になるという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Furniture that serves as a partition for dialogue and accounting. It is said that conversing through this furniture makes one feel as if one has opened a store. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Furniture that serves as a partition for dialogue and accounting. It is said that conversing through this furniture makes one feel as if one has opened a store. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un mobile che serve a parlare e a fare i conti, e insieme fa da divisorio. Dicono che a conversare da dietro venga la sensazione di aver aperto bottega. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t一つ上の世界を見た気になる、ちょっとした段差。何かを主張したい時はここに立って話すといいだろう。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t一つ上の世界を見た気になる、ちょっとした段差。何かを主張したい時はここに立って話すといいだろう。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n"
en: A little step that makes you feel like you've seen the world one step above. If you want to make a statement, you can stand here and talk. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~
en_grezzo: "A little step that makes you feel like you've seen the world one step above. If you want to make a statement, you can stand here and talk. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~"
it: Un gradino da poco che dà l'impressione di vedere il mondo un piano più su. Quando si vuole dire la propria, conviene salirci e parlare da lì. \n# ~I Grandi Comprimari della Città~

jp: \t\t祝い事の為に特別に作られた飾り。各々が思い思いの花で編み上げているので、その形は多様に富んでいる。\n#～ノースティリス紀行・冬版～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t祝い事の為に特別に作られた飾り。各々が思い思いの花で編み上げているので、その形は多様に富んでいる。\n#～ノースティリス紀行・冬版～\n"
en: Decorations made especially for celebratory occasions. Each person weaves them with flowers of his or her own choice, so there is a wide variety of shapes. \n# ~North Tyris Travels, Winter Edition~
en_grezzo: "Decorations made especially for celebratory occasions. Each person weaves them with flowers of his or her own choice, so there is a wide variety of shapes. \n# ~North Tyris Travels, Winter Edition~"
it: Un ornamento fatto apposta per le feste. Ognuno lo intreccia con i fiori che preferisce, e così le forme sono le più varie. \n# ~Viaggio in Tyris del Nord: Inverno~

jp: \t\t孤高の天才作曲家の愛用していたピアノ。既存の曲を独自に解釈した彼の作風をこのピアノは潜在的に受け継いでおり、演奏する際それが音色となって現れるようだ。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t孤高の天才作曲家の愛用していたピアノ。既存の曲を独自に解釈した彼の作風をこのピアノは潜在的に受け継いでおり、演奏する際それが音色となって現れるようだ。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: This piano was the favorite of a solitary genius composer. This piano potentially inherited his unique style of interpreting existing compositions, and this style seems to appear in the tone of the piano when it is played. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "This piano was the favorite of a solitary genius composer. This piano potentially inherited his unique style of interpreting existing compositions, and this style seems to appear in the tone of the piano when it is played. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Il pianoforte prediletto di un compositore geniale e solitario. Pare che abbia ereditato in potenza il suo modo tutto personale di leggere i pezzi altrui, e che a suonarlo quel modo riaffiori nel timbro. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~
